Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 85. Category: form. Super Saiyan.

Transformation
The Saiyan’s hair turns blonde and stands on end and
their eyes turn a vivid shade of emerald while a golden
aura flows upward from them.
Increase your Power by 1
You deal an additional 1d4 to damage
Increase your Movement Speed by 10 ft.
At the end of your turn, you lose 1 Stamina
